q1_issues.issue: "in comedic roles" is not a place — the appearing did not happen at a location called comedic_role — so it answers "in what capacity", not "where", and takes the preposition-named oblique rather than Location.
"in music films" names the medium/work rather than a where-PP, so Location over-commits here too.
"also" sits on the predicate, so the focus filler should be the verb-class lemma (appear), not the subject witness; it is also tagged on only the first of the two coordinated appearing events.

q2_gaps: vague life-stage temporal adjunct ("later in life", "in his youth") — neither a calendar/clock term nor one of the listed speech-anchored deictic constants, so the encoding of later_in_life as a bare Time symbol is unspecified
notes: Antecedent-less "he" is correctly a person-classed witness with its class atom, and both compounds decompose per the part-of-speech test (noun modifier music not exposed, adjective comedic exposed, neither de-derived).
